speaker: Benny
text: More importantly, you've adopted a voice changer? Oh, I call dibs on the Golden Age Flash.

text: Not for long. Hang on, I need that to complete my Justice Society of America collection. You can't just call dibs.

text: Too bad, I call dibs. I can, I did look up dibs in Wikipedia.

text: Dibs doesn't apply in a bidding war.

text: Why Larry? He did. He did.

text: What's the exchange rate? None of your business. Mom, my bar mitzvah box, how much do I got? Thanks. I can cook $2,600 in two trees in Israel.

text: Forget it, guys. If I sell to one of you, the other two are gonna be really mad at me.
